sessions.phase: Phase 1 - Ingest: Schema, Validation, Dedupe & Edit Detection
prompts_or_hashes: phase 1 prompt: FR-1/FR-2, events table + UNIQUE(dedupe_key) migration, POST/GET /api/v1/events with malformed-400 / schema-invalid-200 / dedupe / edit branches, unit + concurrency + DB-constraint tests
notes: edit path leaves an event_edited receipt TODO (receipts table is Phase 6); SIMULATED connector label kept in events router docstring and app/main.py; events.dedupe_key declared nullable so schema-invalid events lacking source/external_event_id don't break UNIQUE (NULLs ignored by Postgres)

sessions.phase: Phase 1 follow-up - Docker boot path, centralized error handler, Docker-based test run
prompts_or_hashes: phase 1 review: docker-compose build + clean up; auto-run alembic upgrade head on boot; show malformed-JSON 400 mechanism; confirm received_at absent-safety; re-run suite via Docker
notes: docker-entrypoint.sh runs alembic upgrade head then uvicorn so fresh containers self-migrate with no manual alembic; MalformedJSONError typed exception handled centrally in main.py returns flat 400 {'error':'malformed_json'} (HTTPException would wrap in {'detail':{...}}); tests kept out of prod image (.dockerignore) so in-container test run binds tests/pytest.ini via volume mount against the compose db service; email-validator confirmed pinned in requirements.txt
sessions.verification: docker compose down -v -> build -> up: entrypoint auto-ran alembic upgrade head (create events table) then uvicorn; \d events in db service shows events_dedupe_key_key UNIQUE CONSTRAINT; live POST: valid create -> duplicate:true -> malformed 400 {'error':'malformed_json'} -> schema-invalid 200 is_valid=false, no manual alembic. pytest re-run in-container against compose db (tests volume-mounted): 26 passed in 0.24s

prompts_or_hashes: phase 1 review: isolate test DB from dev DB so the suite's drop/create never stomps manual walkthrough data
notes: docker/init/01-test-db.sql creates dsw_test on the same Postgres instance at first volume init; compose mounts it and adds TEST_DATABASE_URL (default :5432/dsw_test); conftest hard-assigns DATABASE_URL from TEST_DATABASE_URL before app import because setdefault silently kept the container's dev DATABASE_URL=dsw on the first attempt, which let the suite drop dev events - caught in verification and fixed to a hard assignment
sessions.verification: docker compose down -v -> up created both dsw and dsw_test (\l lists both); POSTed dev event into dev dsw; in-container suite against TEST_DATABASE_URL: 26 passed; afterwards GET dev event still 200 with full body, dev dsw count(*)=1 - test run no longer wipes dev data; final re-run 26 passed in 0.23s with dev event GET still 200

sessions.phase: Phase 2 - Resolve: Identity Resolution & Manual Review
prompts_or_hashes: phase 2 prompt: FR-3, identities/identity_links/manual_review_queue tables, Flow 3, identity policy with fuzzy algorithm choice, manual-review resolve endpoint, exact/phone/fuzzy fixtures, force-merge-rejected test, threshold boundary 0.849/0.85/0.851
notes: fuzzy algorithm = deterministic stdlib difflib.SequenceMatcher.ratio over lowercase display-name tokens, documented in identity_policy_v1.json; confidence_threshold 0.85 in the policy file, not hardcoded; below-threshold builds a manual_review_queue row and the event pipeline halts there; on review resolution the event is linked to the chosen identity (interpret/score/act are future phases); debugged: identity.id was None until flush (Python-side uuid default) so links are created after db.flush(); SQLAlchemy python-side uuid default; test fixtures initially used zero-similarity names which correctly hit the create-fresh path, fixed to shared-token ambiguous names that hit the review path
sessions.verification: pytest against real test Postgres: 50 passed, 0 failed. exact email/phone auto-link and email reuse identity; fuzzy identical above-threshold auto-links; fuzzy shared-token below-threshold -> manual_review_queue with reason and no identity_link; force-merge-below-threshold rejected via should_auto_link gate AND via resolution (no link written); boundary 0.849 no / 0.85 yes / 0.851 yes; HTTP GET manual-review?status=pending and POST resolve (merge_into/create_new) with 400/404/409; alembic 0001->0002 clean on fresh DB

sessions.phase: Phase 2 fixup - DB-enforced identity uniqueness on email/phone, concurrency-safe resolution
prompts_or_hashes: phase 2 review: protect identity resolution from the same SELECT->INSERT race Phase 1 fixed for events; partial unique index on primary_email/primary_phone; catch IntegrityError in exact branches and link to the winner; email+phone concurrency tests
notes: partial unique indexes (WHERE col IS NOT NULL) let multiple NULLs coexist while making same email/phone insert impossible at the DB level; _link_via_exact helper catches IntegrityError, rolls back, re-SELECTs winner's identity and links to it, mirroring ingest.create_event; defect found: after rollback the event ORM object is expired and lazy re-read of event.id raised MissingGreenlet in async SQLAlchemy - fixed by capturing stable event_id before flush/rollback; also discovered the app image was stale (built in Phase 1, lacking 0002/0003) so the in-container entrypoint could not see newer revisions until docker compose build
sessions.verification: full suite 52 passed, 0 failed on real test Postgres; new test_concurrent_email_resolution_creates_one_identity and test_concurrent_phone_resolution_creates_one_identity each use asyncio.gather of two resolve_identity calls for the same email/phone, assert one Identity row and both events linked to it; run 3x consecutive, no flakiness; Docker path: rebuilt stale image, entrypoint auto-applied 0001->0002->0003 to compose dev DB with partial unique indexes present (psql \d identities shows uq_identities_primary_email/phone WHERE IS NOT NULL), in-container suite against isolated dsw_test passed 52

notes: REAL PAID API CALL - approved in writing by Krishnam via Rajat (PRD 9).
